name: faultline-vscode
description: Shows Faultline findings on the lines of a consumer's Python source, through the Faultline language server.

faultline.api.description: The Faultline API the server reads findings from.

faultline.consumer.description: The consumer repository as owner/name. Empty: read from the workspace's git origin.

faultline.pythonPath.description: The Python that runs the server (the Faultline virtual environment). Empty: the FAULTLINE_PYTHON variable, then python.

faultline.backendPath.description: The Faultline backend folder, put on PYTHONPATH. Empty: the FAULTLINE_BACKEND variable.
